text:
24-hour news summary.

1 — DeepSeek open-sourced DeepInfer, its inference framework powering DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash production services. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5990)

2 — Swyx cites DeepSeek's claim of 155 trillion tokens daily per cluster and $38 revenue per GPU-hour, estimating an 80% serving margin. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5991)

3 — OpenAI says it acquired Orchestra Bio to combine drug-development coordination with its Rosalind life-sciences tools. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5992)

4 — Tuesday Labs' Voxel was introduced as a droid butler. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5993)

5 — Omnii-1's developers claim their genome model designed the first AI-generated bacteriophages administered to a patient under compassionate use. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5994)

6 — The Register reports IMF warnings that an AI investment bust, concentrated exposure and circular financing could destabilize global markets. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5996)

7 — Holon-S1's developers say it predicts gene activity and biomarkers from pathology slides, with evaluation across 16 organ types. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5997)

8 — Citing a WSJ draft-IPO report, a post says Anthropic's first-half revenue reached $16.3B, alongside $450B in cloud contracts and further commitments. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5998)

9 — Jim Fan announced open Flora robotics models, claiming Astra-level performance at 125 times lower cost and labeling 200,000 video hours daily. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5999)

10 — Extraltodeus shared English subtitles for a French “slopcore” music video that the channel praises as AI-generated. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6000)

11 — Societies AI introduced an idea-spread simulation with 2,721 personas representing the US population, each with beliefs, routines and social ties. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6001)

12 — Gecko Robotics says its Navy contract quadrupled to $300M, claiming robotic inspections can save up to $8M in repairs per ship. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6002)

13 — Andrew Curran quotes Musk targeting 13 GW of SpaceX AI compute by end-2027 and a 440,000-GPU Vera Rubin training cluster by Q2 2027. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6003)

14 — Former Apple employee Praneeta Pujari introduced UniqueHuman, developing proactive healthcare agents for chronic conditions, starting with migraines. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6004)

15 — NVIDIA announced expanded sovereign-AI standards with the EBU and GPU-accelerated Adobe Frame.io video search. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6005)

16 — Alex Dimakis says Gemini 4 Argon costs two to three times less than frontier peers for similar ML-engineering performance on AutoResearchExam. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6006)

17 — PHP scheduled patches for two critical CVSS 9.2 vulnerabilities for October 21 at 14:00 UTC, with affected versions to be disclosed at release. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6007)

18 — The Hacker News reports Go 1.27.3 and 1.26.10 block eight CA keys over undisclosed security concerns, potentially breaking rebuilt apps' connections. (https://t.me/dlmehr/6008)

--Hermes
